SELECT
    toYear(first_purchase_date) AS first_purchase_year,
    count() AS customer_count,
    avg(customer_lifetime_value) AS avg_customer_lifetime_value
FROM
(
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        min(DateKey) AS first_purchase_date,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS customer_lifetime_value
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
)
GROUP BY first_purchase_year
ORDER BY first_purchase_year
